vulnerabilities.description: DOM-based XSS vulnerability: outerHTML assignment with server-provided HTML. If the server is compromised or returns malicious HTML, arbitrary JavaScript can execute. The element content is replaced without sanitization.
Critical missing code: authorizeConversion() method referenced but implementation not shown. Cannot verify server-side quota/authorization enforcement. Client-side quota checks can be bypassed.
Supply chain risk: Firebase config loaded from meta tag without integrity checks. While Firebase public config is intentionally exposed, ensure no private keys are ever placed in meta tags.

External CDN dependency for PDF.js worker: loaded from https://esm.run/pdfjs-dist@4.0.379/build/pdf.worker.mjs. Risk of supply chain compromise. Consider self-hosting or using Subresource Integrity (SRI) hashing.

Dynamic URL construction with user-controlled data: encodeURIComponent(t.id) used in href. While encodeURIComponent is present, validate that tool.id cannot be crafted as a data: or javascript: URL by backend.

Sensitive error message exposure: Error messages from Firebase auth displayed directly to users (e.g., 'Authentication failed: ...'). May reveal information about backend state. Consider generic error messages.
Silent error handling: network errors are silently caught and retried. If the endpoint is unreachable, the user never receives feedback. Add timeout or max-retry limits.
CSRF token retrieval relies on meta tag without fallback. If meta tag is missing, CSRF protection is silently skipped in reportFileSelected(). Should fail-safe or warn.

recommendations: CRITICAL: Replace outerHTML assignment in poll_controller.js with textContent or a sanitization library (DOMPurify). Use Turbo or similar for safe HTML replacement.
CRITICAL: Verify authorizeConversion() implementation server-side. Ensure quotas cannot be bypassed with client-side script manipulation.
HIGH: Self-host PDF.js worker or add Subresource Integrity (SRI) hashing: <script ... integrity='sha384-...'>
HIGH: Validate tool.id backend cannot contain javascript:, data:, or vbscript: schemes before rendering in href attributes.
MEDIUM: Implement generic error messages in Firebase auth. Log detailed errors server-side only.
MEDIUM: Add retry limits and user feedback for failed polls in poll_controller.js.
MEDIUM: Implement Content Security Policy (CSP) headers to restrict inline scripts and external CDN loads.
LOW: Add fallback handling for missing CSRF tokens in reportFileSelected().
LOW: Audit all file size/type handling server-side; client-side mime-type/extension checks are easily spoofed.
LOW: Review Firebase config for accidentally exposed private keys (API secrets should never be in client-side config).
